rule.statement: The honorable High Court Judges erred when they proceeded to allocate shares to the heirs of Babanis.
rule.supporting_quote: The honorable High Court Judges in varying the judgment of the District Court held that Babanis transferred his land to Sidorisa who is an unknown person. In such a situation the proper course of action is to leave the shares unallotted. The honorable High Court Judges erred when they proceeded to allocate shares to the heirs of Babanis.
